DialogJP.Speaker: Student

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 歳のせいもあるのかな～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生もあんまり夜中に出かけたりしちゃダメだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お互い気を付けていこうね～

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ホシノはどうして夜中まで起きてるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そうだね、夜は早く寝るに限るよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おじさんの方はまあ色々事情があるというか……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: というか先生、心配してくれてるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おじさん感激しちゃうな～

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 素行の良くない生徒への注意だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 素直じゃないなあ先生は、うへへ～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その……色々恥ずかしいし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うへ、じゃあまたね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、おやすみ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: またね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと本を買いたいんだけど。先生、一緒について来てくれない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この辺では買えない本で、遠出しないといけないんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、いいよ。ショッピングモールの方まで行ってみる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうしよっか～、アビドスからはちょっと遠いけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あそこならありそうだしね～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: というか、一も二も無くOKなんだね、さっすが先生～

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それはもちろん、ホシノの頼みだからね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: とりあえず近くで待ち合わせよっか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや～、びっくりしたよ～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 幸運を根性で掴み取ろうとするなんて、さすが先生。おじさん驚きだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: これぞ大人の力！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……でもよく考えると、そのお金で普通にチケット買えたかもね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それを言ったらおしまいだよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大人にはね、後には退けない時があるんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うへへ、そっか～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあとにかく、ありがとね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……えっと、あのアクアリウム、一緒に行かない？チケットも2枚だし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、私でよければ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん、ありがとね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……うへへ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……言ったね、先生？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 約束したからね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ今度、お互いに都合の良い時にでも行こっか。また連絡する～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、この間のアクアリウムの話なんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 有効期限がもうそろそろだから、今度の週末にでもどう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 問題なければアクアリウムの前で待ち合わせってことで、よろしく～

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、大丈夫。楽しみにしてるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 困ったものだねぇ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どこに隠れていても

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 可愛い後輩たちから小言が……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おじさん、悲しいよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: また小言を……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 相変わらずだね、ホシノは

DialogJP.Text: ってことで

DialogJP.Text: いや

DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Text: 今から会えないかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Text: 実はおじさん、いろんなお昼寝グッズを持ってるんだよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気にならない～？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そう言われると、気になってくるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今度また遊びに行っても良い？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: でしょ？

DialogJP.Text: それじゃ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 楽しみにしてて～

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 음, 선생. 휴일에 대책위원회 동아리실로 와줄 수 있겠어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아 그리고, 고래는 물 속에서 숨을 참고 있는 거래. 알고 있었어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으으…… 선생, 자고 일어났더니 허리가 부러질 듯 아프고……. 삭신이 쑤시는데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 이 나이에는 딱딱한 바닥이 아니면 안 되는 건가…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으음…… 저 매트를 쓰는 건 일단 보류해둬야겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아…… 어째서 사람은 아침에 일어나지 않으면 안 되는 걸까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 힘내! 할 수 있어, 호시노 쨩!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 물고기처럼 감을 눈꺼풀이 없으면 차라리 좋겠는데 말이지…… 음냐.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 심해에 사는 물고기 중에는 빛을 만들어서 자기를 보호하는 녀석들도 있대.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아, 그리고 오늘도 보물찾기 할 건데 올래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으헤, 멋지지? 누워서 보면 정말 굉장하다고!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 또 다음에 같이 어디든 가는 걸로.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하암. 새벽까지 깨어있으면 역시 다음 주까지 힘들단 말야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생, 오늘 일은 모두에겐 비밀이야? 선생이라면 입이 무거운 건 알고 있지만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 책을 좀 사고 싶은데 말야. 선생, 도와줄 수 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 찾고 있는 책은 이 동네에는 없어서 말이지…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 근성으로 운을 잡아채는 거 잘 봤어, 선생. 이것이 바로 어른의 힘인가. 나도 배워야겠어. 음음.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……그런데 그 돈으로 그냥 티켓을 샀으면 됐을 텐데 말이지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 살다보면 물러설 수 없는 싸움을 해야 하는 법.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……아쿠아리움, 다음에 같이 가지 않을래? 표도 2장이고 하니…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다음에 시간 날 때 얘기하라고, 선생!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생, 저번에 얻은 아쿠아리움 티켓 말야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 슬슬 기간이 다 되어 가니까, 이번에 같이 가지 않을래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 사실 아저씨에게는 그런 아이템이 더 있어

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um, Sensei, can you come to the Foreclosure Task Force Room when you have time?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I need your help.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, also, I heard that whales hold their breath underwater. Did you know that?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: To the Foreclosure Task Force Room? Okay.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I didn't know that. I guess they are mammals, after all.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh. Sensei, I woke up with this awful back pain... My whole body aches...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is this what duck down is supposed to feel like?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Now that I'm older, maybe I should be sleeping on the hard floor instead.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You should find somewhere more comfortable to sleep next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, in any event, I'll stop using the mat for now.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh, why do I have to wake up in the morning?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My eyelids are so heavy. Help me, Sensei...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Ah, student life.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You got this, Hoshino!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I wish I didn't have eyelids, like a fish. Hmm...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you know?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Some fish that live in the deepest oceans create their own light to protect themselves.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, I'm gonna do another treasure hunt today. Do you want to join me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I see. You won't even skip a single day, will you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I didn't know that. The sea is such a mysterious place.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, Sensei! Look!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh, you put them on the ceiling, huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's pretty!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heh, isn't it cool? It looks amazing when I lie down!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I had so much fun today. Thank you for the gift!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Let's go out again next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay. Goodnight.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A bed under the stars? Sounds dreamy.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: *yawn* The whole week is hard when I stay up until dawn.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Am I getting old?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You shouldn't be up at this hour either, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You need to take care of yourself!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Why are you still awake?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You should go to bed early.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, there are multiple reasons...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you worried about me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wow! I'm touched...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm just nagging you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Be honest, Sensei. Heh heh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, can you please not tell anyone about today? I know you can keep a secret.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um... I just feel so embarrassed.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heh heh! See you later, then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Goodnight, Hoshino!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Later, alligator!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I want to buy a book. Can you help me, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The book I'm looking for isn't available in my town.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay. Should we go to the bookstore in the mall?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, sure. It's a bit far from Abydos,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: but I'm sure they'll have the book I want!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Will you go with me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course, Hoshino.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Let's meet up somewhere nearby and go together.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wow, today was so amazing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I like the way you're determined to win. Is that part of being an adult? I'd like to learn that myself. Hmm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: This is the advantage of being an adult!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...We could have just used that money to buy a ticket, though.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's cheating!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: There are some fights you have to take up in life.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heh heh. Is that so? Well, anyway.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thanks.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hey, so, do you wanna come with me to the aquarium next time? I have two tickets...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll join you. So long as you don't mind.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course. You can always invite me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yeah?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Heehee!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You promise?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Tell me when we can go, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, about the aquarium tickets I got a while ago...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They're gonna expire soon. Should we go?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be waiting in front of the aquarium.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay. I'll see you there.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have a problem.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It doesn't matter where I hide!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My adorable underclassmen always find me and chastise me...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This old-timer is very sad.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You got scolded again?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You never change, Hoshino.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Can't deny that!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: With that being said...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wait

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This is off-topic, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You free later?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This old-timer actually has more stuff like that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Doesn't that get you a little curious?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You've piqued my interest.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Do I have to unlock each item by completing certain conditions?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I guess so?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, sounds good.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll show you another one next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Look forward to it!

DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ก็จะออกอีกสินะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่รู้เลย ทะเลก็เป็นอะไรที่ลึกซึ้งนะเนี่ย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู! ดูนี่สิ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โอ้! ติดเอาไว้ที่เพดานนี่เอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สวยดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อิอิ สวยใช่มั้ยล่ะ? ถ้าได้นอนดูจะยิ่ง
สวยกว่านี้อีก!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้ฉันสนุกมากเลย ขอบคุณ
สำหรับของขวัญด้วยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้คราวหน้า เราไปที่ไหนด้วยกันอีกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้สิ ฝันดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เตียงที่อยู่ใต้แสงดาวแบบนี้...
โรแมนติกจัง~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฮ้าวว พอโต้รุ่งทีไรก็เหนื่อยไปถึงอีกวัน
ทุกทีเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หรือว่าเป็นเพราะอายุมากขึ้นนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครูก็อย่าไปไหนมาไหนจนดึกดื่นล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ต้องระวังตัวดีๆ นะ~

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แล้วทำไมโฮชิโนะถึงโต้รุ่งเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ควรรีบเข้านอนแต่หัวค่ำนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... มีหลายอย่างที่ต้องทำน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าแต่ ครูเป็นห่วงฉันเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ลุงคนนี้เริ่มประทับใจขึ้นมาแล้วแฮะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูก็แค่บ่นไปตามประสาผู้ใหญ่น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่กล้าพูดตรงๆ สินะ ครูนี่ก็ ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เรื่องวันนี้ต้องเก็บเป็นความลับนะ
ฉันเชื่อว่าครูจะไม่เอาไปบอกใคร

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... ฉันเขินน่ะ >_<

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้เจอกันใหม่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ฝันดีนะโฮชิโนะ~

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไว้เจอกันใหม่~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันอยากซื้อหนังสือน่ะ ครูพอจะช่วยหน่อย
ได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หนังสือที่ฉันหาอยู่ไม่มีขายแถวนี้เลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้สิ ลองไปร้านหนังสือที่อยู่ในห้างมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไปสิ ถึงจะอยู่ไกลจากอะบิดอส...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ที่นั่นน่าจะมีหนังสือที่ฉันต้องการนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะไปด้วยกันใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แน่นอนอยู่แล้ว โฮชิโนะจังมา
ขอร้องทั้งที

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มาเจอกันแถวนี้แล้วไปด้วยกันสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮื้ม วันนี้ยอดมากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่อยากจะเชื่อเลยว่าครูจะคว้าโชคมา
ด้วยพลังแบบนั้น นี่สินะที่เรียกว่าพลัง
ของผู้ใหญ่ สงสัยฉันต้องไปเรียนบ้างแล้ว
อืมม

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นี่แหละพลังของผู้ใหญ่!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ว่าเราเอาเงินนั้นไปซื้อตั๋วเลยก็ได้นี่...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อย่าพูดแบบนั้นสิ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เรื่องบางอย่างเราก็ต้องสู้ให้สุดใจนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อะฮ่ะฮ่า งั้นเหรอ? แต่ก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไว้คราวหน้าไปอควาเรียมด้วยกันมั้ย?
ไหนๆ ก็มีตั๋ว 2 ใบแล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อควาเรียมงั้นเหรอ?
ถ้าอยากไปกับครูก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แน่นอน ครูยินดีเสมอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จริงนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า... แหะๆๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถือว่าตกลงแล้วนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้ามีเวลาว่างก็มาบอกฉันนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู ตั๋วอควาเรียมที่ได้มาคราวก่อนน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มันจะหมดอายุอยู่แล้วนะ
เราไปด้วยกันมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันจะรออยู่หน้าอควาเรียมนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้สิ แล้วเจอกันที่นั่นนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ลำบากจริงๆ เลยน้า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ว่าจะไปซ่อนที่ไหน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เสียงบ่นเสียดหูของพวกรุ่นน้องที่น่ารัก
เนี่ย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตาลุงคนนี้รู้สึกเศร้าจริงๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โดนบ่นมาอีกแล้วสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เหมือนเดิมเลยนะ โฮชิโนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็หมายความว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่สิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มันไม่เกี่ยวกับเรื่องนี้ก็จริง แต่ว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเวลาสักหน่อยมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ที่จริงแล้วลุงน่ะ มีของแบบนั้นอยู่อีกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สงสัยใช่มั้ยล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พูดแบบนี้ก็ต้องสงสัยสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: รู้สึกปลดล็อกได้ทีละเงื่อนไขเลย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ใช่มั้ยล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ดีละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้คราวหน้า จะเอาอันอื่นให้ดูนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตั้งตารอได้เลย~

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，下次休假如果有空，能來趟對策委員會的教室嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還有，雖然完全無關，但鯨魚在水裡是憋住呼吸的，你知道嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 對策委員會的教室是吧，了解

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不知道耶。但確實是哺乳類呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，我起床後腰痛到快斷了……還發出哀號……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 果然這年紀不能睡太軟嗎……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 睡在一張像樣的床上比較好唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯……看來得請那張墊子回倉庫了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為什麼人類早上必須起床呢……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 眼皮重到要掉地上了……老師，救命……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 乾脆像魚一樣沒有眼皮的話也許能更輕鬆些……咕噥

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 據說深海魚會讓身體發光來保護自己

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 話說回來，今天也要去尋寶，你要來嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不知道耶，海洋世界真是深奧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘿嘿嘿，很棒吧？這比想像中還要棒呢～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天很開心，謝謝你的禮物

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼，下次再一起去哪裡吧。約好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 被光芒包裹住的床，真是浪漫呀

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嘿～半夜不睡覺，第二天果然會很難受……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師也不能半夜出門唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 星野為什麼半夜還醒著呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 大叔這兒也是有各種情況……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還是說，老師是在擔心我？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 只是在叮嚀品行不良的學生

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，今天發生的事要對大家保密唷？雖然我知道老師的口風很緊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想買些書。老師，可以跟我一起去嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是這附近買不到的書，所以必須去遠一點的地方……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，好啊。去購物中心看看吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就那樣吧～，雖然離阿拜多斯有點遠

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 話說回來，二話不說就答應了呢，不愧是老師～

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那是當然，因為是星野的請求呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 竟然想用毅力抓住幸運，不愧是老師。大叔很驚訝唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……但仔細想想，也許用那筆錢就能正常買票了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 對大人來說，有時候是不能退縮的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……那個，海生館，要一起去嗎？有2張票……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼下次，找個彼此都方便的時間去吧。再連絡～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，關於上次說的海生館

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有效期限快到了，這個週末如何？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果沒問題的話，在海生館前碰面，拜託了～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 都會被可愛的後輩們嘮叨

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然這兩件事沒什麼關聯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實大叔我還有很多這類的道具哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 聽你這麼說，的確是有點好奇

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 所以是會隨著條件達成逐漸解鎖嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次再讓你看看別的吧
